profile.headline: Software Engineering Leader | Microsoft Principal Engineer | Driving High-Impact Software Delivery Across Cloud, Web & Medical Devices
profile.summary:
Results-driven Senior Software Engineer and technical lead with a unique blend of experience spanning full-stack web development, cloud-native architecture, and embedded medical devices. I specialize in designing and delivering scalable, high-performance solutions — from 3D ultrasound workflows and cardiovascular imaging systems to modern customer-facing web platforms.

Known for leading high-performing teams, modernizing legacy systems, and executing complex migrations with zero downtime. At Alaska Airlines, I spearheaded the migration of 29 million customer records to Azure Cosmos DB and launched high-traffic microsites using Svelte and .NET GraphQL services — all while improving performance, reducing support volume, and driving customer satisfaction.

In my 15+ years at Siemens Healthineers, I played a pivotal role across multiple roles — from building critical clinical workflow features to leading architecture and agile transformation efforts. Recognized for turning around team performance and consistently delivering high-quality, testable, maintainable software in regulated environments.

I thrive at the intersection of leadership, hands-on engineering, and continuous improvement. Whether deploying to the cloud or embedded in a medical device, I bring a systems-thinking mindset, a passion for clean architecture, and a bias for delivering results that matter.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering lead on the Guest Profiles team in ECommerce
•	Migrated and consolidated customer account information from two on-prem SQL DBs to a modern Cosmos DB for Mongo DB hosted in Azure, using Azure Functions and Azure Data Service
o	Zero down time migration and transformation of 29 million records
o	Improved searchability and response times for profiles
o	Reduced customer service calls by sanitizing corrupted records.
•	Built and rolled out new GraphQL .NET service in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and updated existing GraphQL domain service (Azure App Service).
•	Built and launched three different JavaScript microsites using Svelte, Svelte Kit, AuthO and AKS:
o	An internal facing tool for customer care agents
o	www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/account/overview 
 primary landing page after users log-in to their loyalty accounts.
o	www.alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/account/find - a customer tool for looking up their loyalty account.
•	Built and maintained a dashboard on Azure for monitoring services and DB performance, scaling, and errors.
•	Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Azure Dev Ops, GitHub and Terraform to deploy and maintain all systems described above.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Svelte · TypeScript · Azure Data Factory · Azure Functions · NoSQL · SQL · Terraform · Microservices · Git · Node.js

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineering lead and agile methodology expert within Surface Commercial Engineering Team
•	Designed and implemented high impact improvement to internal legacy web application using serverless compute-on-demand processing with cloud blob storage and Power Automation to integrate notifications within Microsoft Teams. 
•	Performance Impact: 10x improvement in throughput; large batch requests which previously took days with many manual steps now complete in matter of minutes.
•	Financial impact: unblocked several million dollars of sales.
•	Led initiative which improved discipline and consistency within team agile processes (acceptance criteria, user stories, work break down, estimation, definition of done) resulting in the team having greater feature volume and more predictable delivery compared to before I joined the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JSON · Problem Solving · React.js · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Azure DevOps · Microsoft Power Automate · ASP.NET Core · TypeScript · .NET · Technical Documentation · C# · Application Development · Microservices · ASP.NET · Blazor · Azure Functions

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Feature Lead, Scrum master and process expert on UI and Workflow team. Champion for quality and automation testing within the software organization.
•	Implemented CI pipeline for UI and Workflow subsystem in Azure DevOps.
•	Feature Lead and primary developer for Cardiovascular Workflow Enhancements which improved usability based on pre-release clinical evaluations.
•	Created event driven UI navigation state component to model clinical user workflows resulting improved user experience.
•	Re-engineered legacy annotation component from 100% legacy code that had virtually no requirements to fully testable component with automated regression tests. Implemented in C#, C++/CLI, and C++.
•	Transformed a struggling established team into a team with the reputation of being of the highest performing the company (in terms of number and quality of features delivered as well as number of defects solved).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as Technical Lead and responsible architect for Measurements, Calcs and Reporting. Also served as Interim Release Manager during initial launch of Product Line Software development.
•	Led team of over 15 across 3 locations between the US and India, defining technology roadmap, subsystem architecture, documentation, and work estimates.
•	Released the Calc subsystem as a product line component which was integrated into 1.0 ultrasound product and an offline workstation application.
•	Implemented new WPF and Prism based Report UI component.
•	Recognized as early adopter and champion in switch of source control (ClearCase to TFS/Azure DevOps) and build systems (CMake to MsBuild).

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
•	Feature lead for license-based software configuration and product segmentation. 
•	Implemented dongle tool to support system test at final-assembly without licenses, significantly speeding up manufacturing verification process at 3rd party vendor.
•	Re-engineered legacy backup and restored subsystem using C# to make an extensible, unit testable component.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as feature lead for license-based software configuration and product segmentation.
•	Re-engineered legacy backup and restored subsystem using C# to make an extensible, unit testable component.
•	Released new Report UI component as lead engineer (C#, .NET, WinForms, XML), improving user experience.
•	Software Lead for Volume Viewer application for displaying 3D ultrasound volumes.
•	Extended Autotest tool for playback and record of user workflow, reducing the time execute manual tests.
